prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 6 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1486; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. Patient reported immediate onset of low back pain with muscle tightness and limited range of motion, without loss of consciousness or radiating neurological symptoms at initial evaluation.

Diagnosis: Lumbar strain, acute, related to motor vehicle collision.

Treatment course: Patient attended six outpatient visits over the treatment period. Care included manual therapy, guided therapeutic exercise for core stabilization and lumbar mobility, and patient education on activity modification and posture. Patient was also instructed in a home exercise program and the appropriate use of heat and ice therapy.

Progress: Pain intensity and range of motion improved steadily across visits. By the sixth visit, patient reported near-resolution of symptoms with only occasional stiffness after prolonged sitting. Strength and flexibility measures returned to near baseline.

Prognosis: Good. Patient is expected to make a full recovery with continued independent home exercise. Discharged from active care with instructions to return if symptoms recur or worsen.

Treating provider signature block omitted for synthetic document.
